name: q2s05e-spoke-sees-hub
goal: A Tracker spoke reports the hub's real launch wait reason and runner state (q2s05ejftz). Coverage gap: tracker-due-launch spoke+hub test never read the spoke's launch wait or computers list after a machine exchange.

evidence: MB2 on release 7b36a973a2 showed 'waiting for daniel-primary-mbp to sync' while the primary polled. Expected: queued/held reason from the hub's own report. Cause: hub machine list returned by /sync/machine only held spoke samples.
tracker-due-launch spoke+hub test never exchanged machine telemetry, then read the spoke's launch_status or autolaunch computers; extended it with both.
At a7c4970c72 the extended test failed: launch_status reason 'waiting for daniel-primary-mbp to sync', expected 'queued on daniel-primary-mbp'.
Hub sync response now appends the hub's own current runner report (trackerHubMachines); commit 866eac28a2.
Same unchanged test passed at 866eac28a2 (harness loop record --phase green).
